title: Correction Remediation Commit Policy
principle: Adapter drafts become useful only when a protected backend can preview and record the selected repair policy before any source mutation exists.
public_repo_rule: GitHub Pages may request previews and render commit receipts. It must not store raw memory text, document chunks, transcripts, provider keys, session tokens or execute source mutation.

backend_route.purpose: Preview and record explicitly confirmed remediation adapter commit receipts with rollback metadata.

ui_contract.auto_preview: prepareRemediationAdapter automatically calls previewRemediationCommit when the backend returns an adapter draft

scenarios.expected: A prepared adapter draft automatically requests a protected commit preview.
Users can retry a protected commit preview from the latest adapter draft.
Users can record a backend-owned commit receipt only after a preview exists.
The receipt renders rollback metadata and marks compensating commit requirements.

next.label: Backend-only remediation source execution
next.reason: Commit receipts now exist. The next slice should add backend-only execution gates for supported memory repairs while keeping knowledge mutations review-first.
